name: Sales Lead Scout
description: Find companies with ICP fit, a timely need, sufficient budget, and a reachable decision maker.
targetEntity: A company that can buy a defined professional service

criteria.label: ICP match
criteria.description: The company matches the configured industry, size, stage, and situation.

criteria.label: Service need
criteria.description: The company has a problem that maps to the configured offer.

criteria.label: Reachable decision maker
criteria.description: A founder, CTO, product leader, or operations leader can be contacted.

criteria.label: Budget fit
criteria.description: Available evidence suggests the company can pay the configured minimum.

criteria.label: Delivery fit
criteria.description: The work fits the team's capabilities, scope, and risk tolerance.

signals.label: Recent funding
signals.description: The company announced funding in the configured recency window.

signals.label: Explicit build need
signals.description: A credible source describes a current product, AI, automation, or internal-tool need.

signals.label: Product launch
signals.description: A launch or expansion creates a plausible delivery need.

disqualifiers.label: Below minimum budget
disqualifiers.description: Confirmed budget is below the configured floor.

disqualifiers.label: Staff augmentation only
disqualifiers.description: The buyer only wants hourly personnel without outcome ownership.

disqualifiers.label: Compliance mismatch
disqualifiers.description: The work requires unsupported regulatory or safety capabilities.
